name: Longhand
tagline: A governance layer that keeps an agent honest with plain-file memory
description: Runs on one principle: plain files are the source of truth and the bot's own memory is only a cache, so rules and decisions stay readable and diffable. Routines for inbox watch, sweeps, a nightly memory commit and a Sunday audit arrive switched off - you enable the ones you want.
author: VMVLAX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
